placements.overview: Established in 1932, Lady Amritbai Daga College For Women of Arts Commerce and Science And Smt. Ratnidevi Purohit College of Home Science And Home Science Technology is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra. The institute offers courses like B.Sc., M.Sc., B.Com, B.A. and BBA. These courses are offered in Full Time mode. A total of 18 courses offered by the Institute are available across streams such as Business & Management Studies, Accounting & Commerce, Design, Humanities & Social Sciences, Hospitality & Travel and Science. The institute has all the necessary facilities to the students.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2028

review_content.Placements: In BA, there are no placements specifically for our course. Placements are available for hotel management, fashion designing, etc., but not for BA. My course is related to law and civil services like UPSC or MPSC, so I don’t have information about placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is average. The washrooms are very dirty, but we do have Wi-Fi in the library for students. There is a Xerox room for photocopying, and sports like cricket, badminton, carrom, and chess are free for everyone to play. The canteen food is quite tasty. I don’t know much about medical facilities as I or my friends haven’t needed them. Hostel facilities are available, but since my hometown is Nagpur, I don’t need them. The hostel is clean and nice. Some classrooms are very good, but others have broken benches, which could potentially cause injuries.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: There are good placements, good infrastructure and nice facilities.

review_content.Placements: If students get 80% of marks or more than 80% of marks in their intermediate exams, then they passed with first division and honoured. The highest salary package offered here ranges between Rs. 80,000 per annum and 1 lac per annum. Companies which visit here for placements are Deloitte, Cognizant, ICICI Bank and Infosys. B.Com is a 3-year course with a semester pattern. The academic percentage is important for students to attend an interview in every company for internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are many facilities like Wi-Fi, a library for study, classrooms, a reading room, hostel, food facility, canteen, medical facilities and sports and games facilities. All types of sports facilities like volleyball, basketball, kabaddi, kho-kho, karate and cricket are provided here. Most of the students participate in such games.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2016
reviews_list.review_title: I am very satisfied with this course structure as it is very feasible.

review_content.Placements: My friends got placements in many top companies. I did not apply for placements, though I had joined my father's business. Around 50-60% of students got placed in this course. The remaining students joined their business. Some of them were also married. The highest salary package offered was around 1.5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: I didn't have much idea about the hostels. I was from Nagpur, so I did not opt for the hostel. The food in the mess was a bit uneasy. With friends, it didn't matter much. The infrastructure of the college was pretty nice. My favorite part of the campus was the library, as I loved reading books.

individual_reviews.course: Programme in Hospitality Management and Leadership (PHML) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the finest place where your career begins.

content.Placements: The placement process at our college is very simple and straight.
